newsitem.title: USA: TCW Group studying strategic alternatives - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: TCW Group studying strategic alternatives - WSJ.

text.p: TCW Group Inc, parent of Trust Co of the West, is considering various "strategic alternatives," including the possibility of a sale, the Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.

The newspaper cited a letter sent to clients by the group's chairman and chief executive officer, Robert Day, as saying the possibilities included an acquisition, a merger, a strategic alliance and a public offering.
It also quoted Marc Stern, its president, as saying the group was talking with investment bankers.
"Our whole industry is changing," it quoted him as saying. "There is a need for more product, more size, and we wanted to see if there were alternatives that might position us even better."
TCW manages more than $50 billion in pension money and mutual funds.
